definitions.explanation: The number 100,000, formed as {十|じゅう} (ten) × {万|まん} (10,000). English switches unit here — "hundred thousand" — while Japanese simply counts ten {万|まん}.

examples.japanese: {十万|じゅうまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十万|じゅうまん}⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That video was viewed a hundred thousand times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{十万|じゅうまん}⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the typhoon, more than a hundred thousand households lost power.

notes:
Because Japanese groups digits in fours and English in threes, this is the point where mental conversion becomes error-prone: 100,000 is {十万|じゅうまん} (ten ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧), and 1,000,000 is ⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧ (a hundred ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧).

CONVERSION LANDMARKS:
- ⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧: 10,000
- {十万|じゅうまん}: 100,000
- ⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧: 1,000,000
- ⟦{一億|いちおく}→一億：08929_ichioku⟧: 100,000,000

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {十万|じゅうまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: one hundred thousand yen
- {十万|じゅうまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: one hundred thousand people
- {十万|じゅうまん}⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧: a hundred thousand times
